name: VT-vt
title: VT series surface-mount aluminum electrolytic capacitors, -40 to +105 °C, 2000 h
summary: VT is a family of polarised aluminum electrolytic chip capacitors: a can standing on a plastic base plate with two flat terminals. Ratings run from 4 V to 100 V and 0.1 µF to 6800 µF, ±20 %, in cans from Ø4 × 5.4 mm to Ø16 × 16.5 mm, for use from -40 °C to +105 °C. With rated voltage applied at 105 °C they last 2000 hours (1000 hours for the Ø4 to Ø6.3 cans 5.4 mm tall). Every rating lists its case and maximum ripple current at 120 Hz; many also come in a second or third case with its own ripple figure. The series is RoHS compliant.
key_figures: 2000 h at 105°C, rated voltage (1000 h for Ø4~Ø6.3 × 5.4)

notes: Each rating is named by the series VT, a two-character rated-voltage code (0G 4 V, 0J 6.3 V, 1A 10 V, 1C 16 V, 1E 25 V, 1V 35 V, 1H 50 V, 1J 63 V, 2A 100 V) and a three-character capacitance code in µF: two significant figures and a power of ten, with R marking the decimal point (R33 is 0.33 µF, 4R7 is 4.7 µF, 101 is 100 µF).
A case size in brackets is a further case for the same rating.
The capacitance code of the 63 V 56 µF rating should read 560.
Load life follows from the case: 1000 h for Ø4 to Ø6.3 cans 5.4 mm long, 2000 h for all others.

operation.text: Neither the rated voltage nor the rated temperature is to be exceeded in service.
Keep stock indoors between +5 °C and +35 °C with relative humidity below 75 %.
The can top carries, in black ink, the capacitance in µF (for example 470), the rated voltage (for example 16V) and the series VT, with a dark band over the negative side.

The listed ripple currents hold at 120 Hz. For 50 Hz to 10 kHz and above, multiply by the coefficient for the case diameter and capacitance band; the coefficient is 1.00 at 120 Hz and rises with frequency.
The 4 V to 25 V ripple currents are given at 105 °C; the 35 V to 100 V ripple currents are given at 85 °C.
